newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains rise as sterling falls.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains rise as sterling falls.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures firmed on sterling's fall against other European currencies.
Active May wheat was last traded 1.05 stg higher at 98.90 stg. May volume was 294 lots of a total 531 on wheat.
"There's nothing more sinister than currency driving the market," one said. Sterling's fall had made UK grain look a bit more competitive.
"People are a bit more comfortable. It's back on a friendlier track, helped by currency," one said.
With plenty of long holders, slightly higher volume in a rising market was no surprise, he said. Falls in recent days have been accompanied by slow trading.
